items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well Philly Ray used to play with him.

ctx.x: He played with Philly Ray too didn't he? Huh? Bill Galaty used to play with Philly Ray too didn't he? Yes.
Well Philly Ray used to play with him.
Well I mean. He used to hire him.
